saints.name: The Presentation of the Lord
saints.title: Feast of the Lord
saints.shortBlurb: Forty days after Christmas the Church keeps the day the Infant Christ was brought to the Temple and hailed by Simeon as a light to the nations…
biography: According to the Gospel of St. Luke, forty days after his birth Mary and Joseph brought the Child Jesus to the Temple in Jerusalem to present him to the Lord and to offer the sacrifice of the poor. There the aged Simeon took him in his arms and blessed God, calling him “a light to the revelation of the Gentiles,” and the prophetess Anna gave thanks.

Kept in the East as the “Meeting” of the Lord and in the West as Candlemas, the feast is marked by the blessing of candles and a procession, honoring Christ as the light who came into his Temple. It falls on the second of February, forty days from the Nativity.
saints.knownFor: The presentation of the Infant Christ in the Temple and the canticle of Simeon.
